name: Red's Major Power Tier List
subject: major-powers
methodology: Transcribed from the five-part Red's Major Power Tier List by Spirit Island Archive, from yt-dlp auto-generated captions (scripts/fetch-transcripts.mjs, scripts/extract-card-tiers.mjs). Each part announces the band it covers: Part 1 (dHe0_n86nq4) F and D tier, Part 2 (rkuXUmf7kpM) C tier, Part 3 (Hc3bLAkiO5o) B tier, Part 4 (Olm9L9CnHfc) A tier, Part 5 (Hnm_rD4ziRc) S tier. The two [OUTDATED]-titled major power videos in the same playlist are superseded and were deliberately not ingested. A card is rated here ONLY where the captions name it verbatim inside a part that covers exactly one band, so the band comes from the video's own declaration rather than from proximity to a spoken tier letter, which is unreliable in conversational speech. This list is therefore partial: Part 1 covers two bands (F and D), so no F or D rating is recorded here, and any card named across several parts is held back too. Those are pending owner adjudication of the near-miss batch in .scratch/card-tier-lists/extraction/near-miss-review.md. An absent card means this list does not record what the source said about it - never that the source rated it poorly.
